paragraphs: Rav Achadvoy bar Ammi: Bekhorot 39a; Me'ilah 13a; Bava Metzia 91a. Rav Yosef responds to his question in Shabbat 83b; Niddah 37b. In Rav Sheshet’s name; Zevachim 97a has Achavoya—an error. He asked Rav Sheshet and Rav. He is Ulla, who upset his mother’s ways (see there). His mother was Rav Sheshet’s nurse. He became mute and forgot his learning; she asked Rav Sheshet to pray for him, and he recovered, Bava Batra 9b. He asked Rav Sheshet, “What is the law regarding one who penetrates himself?” He answered, “You have disgusted us,” Sanhedrin 55a; see Arukh. He raised a contradiction to Rav Chisda, Pesachim 75a. He asked Rav, Chullin 113b: I think an error for Rabbah or Rava. This caused She'erit Yosef’s error in saying he asked Rav and counting him among Rav’s students: Rav Sheshet was Rav Huna’s student, and Rav Huna was Rav’s student. His mother prepared a remedy for someone, Shabbat 109b.
